acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct notch is visible at the distal apex of the fin lobe. The posterior margin (trailing edge) exhibits irregular serrations and small indentations. A localized high-intensity pixel cluster is present on the anterior margin (leading edge) approximately one-third of the distance from the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: The fin surface exhibits a pattern of faint, low-contrast, approximately circular spots of higher pixel intensity distributed across the visible medial section.
